phaseOwnership.1: Versioned contract, schema validation and migration mapping only
phaseOwnership.2: Order/delivery foundation, SLA decisions and persistence

guards.cutoff: deadline - MAX(45, authoritative valid end-to-end upperBoundMinutes)
guards.simultaneousNotices: storeStatus, demand.level and alcohol.status are independent; HIGH and UNAVAILABLE must coexist
guards.freshness: Re-evaluate current estimate atomically on submit; stale/changed promise =>409 reconfirmation; unavailable authoritative service =>503; no optimistic45 fallback
guards.laterStages: Recheck acceptance/preparation/dispatch/arrival/handover with remaining time; retain original promise, no retroactive refusal just because cutoff for new orders passed
guards.atomicHandover: Actual deadline AND age18+ if alcohol AND PIN, with same-person presence/actor/revision, in one transaction; no partial completion
guards.privacy: Only outcome, method, one server timestamp and courierId per operational linkage; no document photo/number/DOB/type or free text
guards.hotel: No unattended/third-party/reception handover; adult intended recipient present; no redelivery on same order
guards.refund: Verification refusal ->full automatic compensation incl fees, no customer cost; idempotent outbox and provider confirmation, no distributed transaction claim
guards.retention: Age evidence inherits order dossier retention anchored at last accounting entry, general6 years subject to legal special rules/holds; not order date
